Phoebe Litchfield hits historic first T20 century of her career as Sydney Thunder win highest-scoring WBBL match ever
Thursday 26 November 2026 13:09, UK
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
A look back at the best of Phoebe Litchfield's stunning unbeaten 121 for the Sydney Thunder, as they beat Adelaide Strikers in the highest-scoring WBBL game ever.
